reader.requirement: At --std 85, after a successful CLOSE of a report file without the REEL or UNIT phrase (plain, WITH NO REWIND, WITH LOCK), the file is out of the open mode and no longer associated with its file connector: a further CLOSE answers 42 and an OPEN may associate it again (except after LOCK, which answers 38). A REEL/UNIT close leaves it open.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.CloseWithLockLocksFileConnector: from 2002 the file CONNECTOR is locked (_locked set); at 85 the PHYSICAL FILE is (PhysicalFileTable.State.ClosedWithLock), per §1985:IX.1.3.4/II.2
the same behavior read back by the next OPEN (SharedOpenAttempt): 38 for the connector from 2002, for the physical file at 85

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the removal from the open mode (FileConnector.Close `_openMode = false`, SharedClose deregistration) is edition-independent; only WHAT a LOCK close locks differs, which is GR3 symbol E, not this rule
reader.witnesses-cover: part: both witnesses use ordinary sequential files; the report-file case and its LOCK and NO REWIND forms are covered by the probe

probes.printed: CLOSE1=00 CLOSE2=42 REOPEN-EXT=00 NOREW=07 AFTER-NOREW=42 LOCK=00 LOCK-AGAIN=42 REOPEN-LOCKED=38; report file holds DE\r\nDE\r\n (the EXTEND reopen appended)
probes.expected: after plain, NO REWIND and LOCK closes the report file is not open (42 on the next CLOSE); it reopens after a plain close (00) and appends; after LOCK the reopen is 38
a CLOSE with REEL/UNIT is outside the rule and leaves the file open, so the next plain CLOSE succeeds

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.4.2.4 GR6  (4.2.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR6

reader.notes: FileConnector.Close clears the open mode in a finally block and SharedClose removes the connector from the physical file's open set, so the file is disassociated on every non-REEL/UNIT close. The 85-only arm for LOCK locks the physical file, as the 1985 text requires.

refuter.evidence: Probe r1decl.cob: after a successful CLOSE WITH LOCK every following CLOSE form (NO REWIND, REEL, UNIT FOR REMOVAL) found the file out of the open mode and raised the error declarative (DECL-RAN 2..4), so LOCK removes it from the open mode like a plain close; the reader's p1close shows REEL/UNIT leaving it open (CLOSE1=00 after REEL and UNIT FOR REMOVAL) and the reopen after a plain close appending. Probe r5idx.cob: after the failed OPEN the CLOSE is 42 and the indexed file the report file named still reads K001BRAVO, so a failed open left no association. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.4.2.4 GR6 (the text is in GR6).
